value.title: omp-statusline-name
value.summary: The pij seat id reliably appears in the omp status bar: setSessionName is retried until it takes, and a visible fallback surface exists when it does not.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Diagnosis (pij-upset-anglerfish, 2026-09-01, .harness/temp/omp-statusline-fix.md — vendored at assets/inputs/diagnosis.md): the omp status bar shows the pij id via `pi.setSessionName(self)` at `.pi/extensions/pij/index.ts:321` (rs path) and `:364-371` (legacy path). It is ONE-SHOT at session_start and fire-and-forget. OMP's SessionManager.setSessionName returns boolean with three silent false exits; the bridge discards it, so pij never learns it missed, and the omp branch SKIPS the `ctx.ui.setStatus` fallback entirely. Census of 279 sessions: bimodal — name lands at 0.13-0.35s or never (a startup race; the LLM auto-titler then wins with source:auto). Config, argv, model, spawn mode all ruled out. Nothing was ever dispatched to fix it.

sections.name: goals
value: G1 Retry: after session_start, re-issue setSessionName until getSessionName() (or the extension's readable equivalent) equals the seat id, with bounded attempts (e.g. at 0, 250ms, 1s, 3s, 10s) and once more on the first user turn / first pij delivery.
G2 Fallback surface: on omp ALSO set ctx.ui.setStatus(PIJ_STATUS_KEY, self) so the id has a second visible surface; remove the omp-only skip of the fallback.
G3 Honest failure: if the name still has not taken after the retry window, emit one visible extension notice line (`pij: could not set omp session name — id is <self>`), never silence.
G4 Both daemon generations: rs path and legacy path get identical behaviour through one shared helper.

sections.name: non_goals
value: No changes to omp itself (dist/cli.js is not ours).
No change to the Claude statusline (already fixed in ~/.claude).

value.claim: LIVE: 10 hand-started `omp` sessions in tmux, back to back; every status bar shows the pij id (tmux capture of each footer pasted). Pre-fix census rate was roughly 1 in 4 missing, so 10/10 is the bar.

LIVE forced miss: with the native set stubbed/forced to fail (e.g. temporarily make setSessionName return false via a test hook or run with the name pre-set to source:user), the setStatus row shows the id AND the notice line appears. Transcript pasted.

Unit: fake pi API whose setSessionName fails N times then succeeds → helper retries per schedule, stops once the readback matches, sets status regardless; fails forever → notice emitted exactly once. RED-first on the pre-fix tree.
`just typecheck`, extension vitest, `harness checks` green (npm ci first in a fresh worktree).

value.title: Retry + fallback + live 10/10 proof
value.brief: Implement the shared helper, wire both call sites, prove AC1-AC4, PR into main.
